name: Measures Adoption
description: Steers a scenario up a Measure Maturity Ladder (L0 unmeasured → L5 federated) gated at every rung by the `measures-health validate scenario` CLI verdict: declare each stateful domain's analytical questions ("how many backlog items closed this week") as named, typed, parameterized measures on packages/measures-go, so search-hub can match a question, deterministically resolve a time_window, and auto-answer safe read-only measures with provenance. Covers the expected/covered/waived domain decision table, substrate choice (SQL aggregate / live call / CQRS event-sourced read-model), the proto binding + manifest measure block + governance effect, serving via one Registry/spec table, deleting the old monolithic /stats path (greenfield), and proving real adoption with the --probe behavioral check at full tier. Closes the EM `measures` dimension. Cites packages/measures-go/README.md and docs/concepts/MEASURES.md.
